title: Automatic baseline correction of 1D NMR spectra using a spline-constrained neural network

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Automatic baseline correction of 1D NMR spectra using a spline-constrained neural network》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Baseline distortion remains a persistent source of error in NMR spectroscopy, compromising lineshape fidelity, weak-peak detection, and quantitative peak integration.
